name: Audiobook Library
description: Replaces the web player for audiobooks with a chapter-aware player modeled on Audiobookshelf's: whole-book progress with chapter marks, chapter skip, per-book speed and synced resume. Adds Audible chapters and Author/Series pages.
overview: Chapter-aware audiobook player with Audible chapters and Author/Series pages
